DML.SELECT: SELECT incident_type_task_id as "id", incident_type_id as "incidentTypeId", incident_state_id as "incidentStateId", stretch_id as "stretchId", task_type_id as "taskTypeId", alias as "alias", description as "description", operation_description as "operationDescription", mandatory as "mandatory", position as "position", auto as "auto", on_change as "onChange", delay as "delay", rerun as "rerun", road_impact_id as "roadImpactId", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.ims_incident_type_tasks WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.ims_incident_type_tasks (incident_type_task_id, incident_type_id, incident_state_id, stretch_id, task_type_id, alias, description, operation_description, mandatory, position, auto, on_change, delay, rerun, road_impact_id, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id=getNextId{'conf.ims_incident_type_tasks'$'incident_type_task_id'}, :incidentTypeId, :incidentStateId, :stretchId, :taskTypeId, :alias, :description, :operationDescription, :mandatory, :position, :auto, :onChange, :delay, :rerun, :roadImpactId, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.ims_incident_type_tasks SET incident_type_id = :incidentTypeId, incident_state_id = :incidentStateId, stretch_id = :stretchId, task_type_id = :taskTypeId, alias = :alias, description = :description, operation_description = :operationDescription, mandatory = :mandatory, position = :position, auto = :auto, on_change = :onChange, delay = :delay, rerun = :rerun, road_impact_id = :roadImpactId, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE incident_type_task_id = :id
